column3: Cron is said in words by a small client reader (every N minutes, hourly, daily, weekdays, weekends, named days, monthly on a day) and falls back to the raw cron for anything else, always followed by the trigger's time zone
column4: No cron-to-words dependency in web; the shapes cover the presets and what the agent writes. The server stays the one cron validator (bad_args)
